hypothesis: H4: The public effect model transfers a killed Loot Hoarder into one extra opponent hand card, but race evaluation drops that future resource while rewarding removal of its deathrattle value. Price opponent public hand_size symmetrically with our hand using the existing turn_hand coefficient 0.973, without predicting card identities. This should reduce overvalued draw-deathrattle clears and visible bounce lines while preserving high-attack clear alternatives. Parent DARCL2, one scoring expression only, identical deck/mulligan/search caps. Refute if actual policy continuations do not produce repeatable net rescues, or fresh full games fail to show Astra gain. Unlike PRR this does not learn/reweight board, race, secret or own-hand features; unlike TRPLY it adds no reply or recovery nodes.
fixed_coefficient: Reuse cfg turn_hand=0.973; no grid search or fitted new coefficient.

continuation_screen.sources: All initial/late1 TRAIN roots only, 264 roots and 792 paired worlds; all already seen. No independent label holdout claim.
continuation_screen.advance_if: worlds 0/1 total paired actual-policy net > 0 and at least two net-positive source seeds; report world2 but it is also seen.

negative_controls: Visible Freezing Trap bounce increases opponent public hand count too; check resulting original-win regressions and non-Astra families.
causal_limit: The motivating teacher routes also change development or target sequence, so missing resource value is a hypothesis, not a proven explanation of those wins.
